headline: Frontier Ledgers Stir as Base Flips Continue
war_summary: Since the last edition, event books have thickened on several contested fronts. The war remains without a victor, and the 34-town standard is unmet. Weathered Expanse logged 52 base events in the past day, up from 46, with nine in the latest two hours; its nine bases stand four Colonial, three Warden and two neutral. Nevish Line rose from 23 daily events to 35, including eight in the latest two hours, and remains divided four Warden, two Colonial and two neutral. Marban Hollow’s daily count climbed from 26 to 32, with six recent events; Kuura Strand edged from 31 to 32, though only two fell in the latest two hours. Linn Mercy recorded ten events in the day and three in the latest two hours, its latest base shift at 05:06 UTC. Godcrofts’ two recent events were at Argosa, where a base became neutral; the map now has eight Colonial bases and one neutral. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have logged no events in the latest two hours.
